question: Does the frozen radial Test 6 clock pass the longevity prerequisite before Test 7?

method.action: SS OCF 1 flat action, U=s-s²+s³, V=0.25-0.4s+0.2s², zeta=0.1. Neutral response extension Z=1+0.2s (M0=m=1); same underlying action, separate registered active-neutral sector.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1; r,t in m^-1; fields in m; frequencies in m; dimensionless tick shift Omega*delta_t/(2*pi).
method.domain: Saved omega_Q=0.900 profiles; R=80,h=0.1 and h=0.05. Response R=160 independently. Fixed readout r=0.1.
method.boundaries: Regular origin and zero radial fields at finite R. Longevity uses original logged sponge beyond r=60. Response uses no sponge; earliest outer reflection cannot reach core by t=100.
method.initial_data: Exact saved discrete profiles/eigenmodes; chi=0.001 f/max(f/r), chi momentum=0, Phi momentum=-i*0.9*Phi. Response ra=A*c*cos^4(pi*(r-c)/(2*w)) inside |r-c|<w, zero outside; (c,w)=(18,3) incoming, optional (4,2) outgoing. Initial d_t(ra)=+d_r(ra) incoming and negative outgoing; p_a=Z*d_t(ra). Amplitude A is the coefficient of this prescribed radial packet; it is not an exact peak a normalization.
method.solver: Longevity reuses registered kick-drift-kick at dt=.04,.02; all 100 nominal periods, sample every .2. Response uses RK4 of discrete reciprocal Hamiltonian at dt=.02, mesh/time .01; samples .1; t=100. First solve exact Taylor coefficients a1,deltaPhi2,deltaChi2 on evolving no-pulse baseline; save all predictions before full nonlinear runs. No parameter fit. Neutral stiffness G^T Z_faces G, G b=r_face*d_r(b/r).
method.tolerances: Locked criteria below. L2 means Euclidean norm of uniformly sampled local traces over t=0..100. Numerical error is direct coarse/fine difference, no assumed Richardson order. Deterministic error floor 0.2% for response approximation; unresolved if signal RMS <=1e-12. Resource ceiling 1800 s wall, 1024 MiB, 100 MiB output.

hypotheses.prediction: The frozen calibration survives full refined longevity and predicts an even, amplitude-squared local response within registered error controls.
Unstable clock, sign-odd response, persistent prediction residual or ambiguous local ticks invalidates the tested approximation.
